channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
item.description: How we fully migrated github.com away from CSS-in-JS. The post Improving site performance by shipping more CSS appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (4 sources: frontendfocus, githubblog, javascriptweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Build products that help people build their lives
item.description: Put your skills towards creating the products and tools that redefine investing at an instutition with a startup mindset and a Fortune 500 foundation. (3 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: How Anthropic Made Claude's Apps 3x Faster in Two Weeks
item.description: Inside our performance sprint: the benchmarks Claude built, the loop each Slack thread ran, and the guardrails that let us ship 3,000 changes safely. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
item.description: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator. (3 sources: cloudflare, frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Agents can now set up your website’s security with Turnstile Spin
item.description: Misconfiguring Turnstile by skipping backend validation leaves sites exposed to bots. Turnstile Spin fixes incomplete setups by using your preferred AI coding agent to wire up server-side verification. (2 sources: cloudflare, frontendfocus)

item.title: django-modern-rest@0.16.0 release
item.description: Hi everyone, I am the release manager of django-modern-rest :) django-modern-rest 0.16.0 is out! Is this your first time that you hear about this project? (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: EmDash 1.0: An Open Source CMS for Astro
item.description: Announcing EmDash 1.0, a stable, free and open source CMS built on Astro. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: plugins can now be submitted
item.description: The EmDash plugin registry launches with 1.0. Here's how to scaffold a sandboxed plugin, publish it from your own Atmosphere account, and get it listed for EmDash sites. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Version 31 of developer browser Polypane is out now
item.description: This release has a new canvas layout that lets you freely arrange panes on an infinite canvas. The elements panel now lets you filter styles, search the DOM… (1 source: frontendfocus)
